subject: Implement step idempotency framework
description:
Build `capo/workflows/_idempotency.py` — generator for stable idempotency keys derived from workflow + step + deterministic input, plus persistence helper that records keys in DBOS step state so retries are safe.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `idempotency_key(workflow_id, step_name, *deterministic_args) -> str` returns a stable key.
- [ ] All `@DBOS.step` calls with external side effects (subprocess spawn, `amc.send`, any DB insert NOT already wrapped by the BEGIN IMMEDIATE retry helper) generate AND persist an idempotency key.
- [ ] Persistence uses DBOS's step-state mechanism so a re-entered step skips work whose key already succeeded.
- [ ] Helper provides a `@idempotent_step` decorator (or equivalent) that wraps a step body.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Same key, different payload: re-using the same key with different content is rejected as a programmer error.
- [ ] Workflow re-entry mid-step: persisted key prevents duplicate side effect.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: same inputs produce identical key
• Unit: different inputs produce distinct keys
• Integration: workflow restart between key persist and side-effect re-entry: side effect runs at most once

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.6, 5.13, 9.3
